title: Electrostatic force magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the electrostatic force at point A as F = mg sin30° - m(g/4) = mg/4.

title: Newton's second law application
description: Important: Applies Newton's second law along the incline at point A, accounting for both gravitational and electrostatic forces.

title: Work-energy theorem setup
description: Important: Sets up the work-energy theorem between points A and B, including both gravitational and electrostatic work.

title: Potential difference calculation
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the potential difference U_AB = -kq/L from the work-energy equation.

title: Distance recognition
description: Important: Recognizes that AB = L/2 and uses this in gravitational work calculation.

title: Sign error in force direction
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly assigns direction to electrostatic force (attractive vs repulsive) in Newton's law setup.

title: Energy conservation sign error
description: Pitfall: Makes sign errors in work-energy equation, particularly with electrostatic potential energy change.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Verifies that final answers have correct units (force in N, potential in V).
